The Smart Robot Car is a learning kit based on Ard programming,which is an integrated solution for robot learning and programming education.

The kit comes with tutorial, which contains detailed assembly tutorials, codes, libraries and courses. You can complete this project on your own through tutorial.It will improve your hands-on ability and thinking ability.
Contains R3 mainboard, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, bluetooth module, line tracking module, etc.The bluetooth module achieve the function that controlled by an Android phone.

The smart robot car can achieve functions such as line tracking, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, infrared remote control, bluetooth connection, etc. You can also expand other functions through programming by yourself.
It is not only designed for Arduino learners, but also as a toy for children. Of course, as a gift to friends is also a very good choice.
